name: CL1411.1-1148 outskirts (Hubble)
blurb: An outskirts field of the galaxy cluster CL1411.1-1148, seen by Hubble.
label: cl14111-hubble
story: Hubble pointed at the outskirts of this distant galaxy cluster, where newcomer galaxies fall in, to study how spiral galaxies become lenticulars.

claims.text: CL1411.1-1148 is a galaxy cluster in the ESO Distant Cluster Survey (EDisCS)
CL1411-1 is a Hubble pointing of program 13393, which imaged positions in the outskirts of intermediate-redshift galaxy clusters
Program 13393 studies galaxy transformation in the infall regions of clusters
The program seeks what transforms spiral galaxies into lenticular (S0) galaxies
